name: adhd-hub
description: Connect Cursor to your self-hosted ADHD Progress Hub: session continuity skills, project registry skill, env-check, always-on Hub rule, and BYO MCP wiring.

ADHD_HUB_MCP_URL.title: ADHD Hub MCP URL
ADHD_HUB_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint for your self-hosted Hub (example: http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp or https://hub.example.ts.net/mcp)

ADHD_HUB_AUTH_TOKEN.title: ADHD Hub auth token
ADHD_HUB_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token matching ADHD_HUB_AUTH_TOKEN on your Hub server. Never commit this value.
